To Foreign Section

following report and ascertain
details:

board the ship. Efforts

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Route Detective Station,
No. L. O. D. 787.
Date December 11, 1929.
D.D. 12-11-29.

Subject (in full) Arms for the Nationalist Government.

Made by Temp. Cl. Ass't Cook. Forwarded by Tho Robertson C.D.I.

The following arms, etc., which were brought
in the German steamer "Claus Rickmers" were unloaded
at Woosung on December 10th and were originally intended
to be dispatched to Nanking by the S.N. Railway, but,
owing to the present political unrest, were delivered
to the arsenal at Lunghwa.

4 cases Howitzers.
378 " Munitions.
8 " Machine guns and accessories.
7 " Gas protection implements.
1 case Field glasses.
1 " Leather carbine shoe.

John Knox
T. C. A.

AR.
11 12/24

A/D. C. I.
Copy to
Authorised
Rev
11/12

档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
路线侦探站，
编号 L. O. D. 787。
日期 1929年12月11日。
D.D. 1929年12月11日。

主题（全称）运往国民政府的武器。

由临时警员助理 Cook 撰写。经刑事侦缉处探员 Tho Robertson 转呈。

下列武器等物由
德国轮船“Claus Rickmers”号运抵，于12月10日在吴淞卸货，原计划
经沪宁铁路发往南京，但
鉴于目前的政治动荡，已交付
给龙华兵工厂。

4箱榴弹炮。
378箱弹药。
8箱机枪及配件。
7箱防毒装备。
1箱野战望远镜。
1箱皮革卡宾枪套。

John Knox
T. C. A.

AR.
11 12/24
